274784125.description:
Glass Insulator Lot - 3 Pieces
Hemingray and American Manufactured
Aqua Teal and Clear, Vintage Mid-Century Era
This collection of three vintage glass insulators represents a significant era in American telecommunications history. Used primarily to insulate telegraph and telephone wires from their wooden support poles, these heavy glass pieces are prized by collectors for their industrial aesthetic and vibrant glass colors. This lot provides a balanced display including a classic aqua teal piece and two clear glass specimens.
Pieces Included:
Hemingray Insulator, Aqua Teal Glass, embossed "HEMINGRAY" with beaded drip points - minor base fleabites
Clear Glass Insulator, embossed "MADE IN U.S.A.", smooth base - excellent vintage condition
Unmarked Clear Glass Insulator, smooth base - excellent vintage condition
Condition:
The lot is in very good vintage condition. The teal Hemingray insulator shows typical minor chipping and roughness along the drip points on the base, which is characteristic of utility-grade glass. The clear insulators are notably well-preserved with no significant chips or cracks. All pieces retain their original glossy transparency without signs of glass disease or mineral cloudiness.

ctbids-47173-5494101.description:
Beautiful mixed collection of crystal and decorative glass pieces featuring several recognized makers, plus decorative picture frames. Everything shown is included.
The collection includes two Lalique France frosted crystal bird figurines in different poses. The birds feature Lalique’s distinctive frosted and polished appearance, with photographed markings/labels supporting the attribution. Also included is a Swarovski crystal angel figurine, featuring a highly faceted clear crystal body and wings with frosted head and arms. The Swarovski swan mark is visible on the underside. The clear seated rabbit/bunny figurine is marked Daum France on the underside and features a substantial sculpted crystal form with detailed ears, paws, and body. Also included is a Waterford cut-crystal shaker with pierced metal top. The metal top shows tarnish/oxidation consistent with age and previous use. Decorative picture frames are also included in this collection. These complement the crystal and glass pieces and are included exactly as photographed.

All items may show light scratches, shelf wear, tarnish, label residue, or other signs of previous display and handling. Please review all photographs carefully for exact condition, markings, quantity, and everything included.
Maker identifications are based on the signatures, etched marks, and labels visible in the photographs. No original boxes or paperwork are included unless pictured.

Each specimen, neatly labeled in its own compartment, includes classics such as Azurite, Barite, Quartz, Mica, Iron Pyrite, and more, offering a colorful and educational display for collectors, students, or enthusiasts.
The collection comes in its original cream-colored sturdy box, making it ideal as a gift for budding geologists or as a unique display item for your collection. Individual stones are unmounted and vary in size and shape, showcasing their natural textures and hues. Measuring approximately 7.5 x 5.5 inches, the set is compact for easy storage or display.
